Section  7  of  the  principal  enactment  is  hereby
by  the  substitution  for  the  words  “signature  of  the
testator or testatrix”, of the words “signature and the
left  or  right  thumb  impression  or  any  other  finger
impression or the toe impression as the case may be,
of the testator ”;
by the insertion immediately after that section of the
following  proviso:-
“Provided however that, in the event the signature
or left or right thumb impression or any other finger
impression as the case may be, of the testator  cannot
be obtained due to any reason, the testator shall affix
his toe impression and the notary public shall state
such reason in his attestation.”.
